data.notes: The report gets the core diagnosis right. It tags the deal Value proof, says 'the same thing' was the real reason, and surfaces the declined three-month decline analysis, the unanswered request for a business case, and the rate-only one-pager. It never cites the rep's 'If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this' line or labels it opinion; it only says the rep undercuts his own conclusion. It also hedges on whether we followed the incumbent into a rate conversation, though the rep's emails and his 'get more room on the rate' takeaway show we did. The trigger insight also omits that the pain was owned by someone who couldn't sign.
